notes.subject: memer
notes.rationale: olgeta i no gat wanpela mining: 'ol memer i kirap pikinini' (kalabus) o 'ol dia i abrus' — mi holim kalabus.

notes.subject: יחולל
notes.rationale: חול i tok 'turong / ring / wokim kalabus' — ol tanima i no gat wanpela tok.

notes.subject: אילות
notes.rationale: ol memer — dispela tok i stap long Tesirim 29 tasol.

notes.subject: kol-Yahwe
notes.rationale: repiten bilong 'kol bilong Yahwe' i kamap sevenpela long salim — wanpela kol i ken tanim olgeta. Not lost, but the sevenfold structure frames the verse.

translation: Bilong Yahwe i wokim kamap ol kalabus long ol memer; Yahwe i lusim ol gumi long ol bus. Long haos tempel bilong en, olgeta i tok: Kavod!
